use_cases: Compare before/after photos in photo editing applications
Display product image comparisons in e-commerce listings
Show property transformation in real estate listings
Demonstrate visual differences in creative tools
Compare design mockups in dev-tools workflows
ai_summary: An interactive image comparison slider component that uses spring animations from the motion library to smoothly reveal differences between two images. Supports both click-drag and hover-based sliding modes with touch and mouse event handling for cross-platform compatibility. Built with React Context for state management and MotionValue for performant animations.
